note: Test values only (spec v0.5 §9.2), never production's: lease 60 s; fakework 2.0 test_units a day and 1.5 per item. fakework.subscription is configured supervised-only and anthropic.api is an API route outside the test family, both for T11b. fakework.api is T19e's test API route. Each route names the workers it may run; a test route runs only fakework. launch_closure is pending, as it is everywhere until the owner records both gating N5 items. A sweeper runs every 15 s, and a gap in its heartbeat over 30 s (the gap threshold) is the authority's own outage. The authority beats its own liveness on the same 15 s timer. A host's records replayed after a lapse are judged with 1 s of clock skew (§2.5 requires under 1 s). reassign_across_hosts is left out, so it is false, as on the Mac-only gate M. A host contacts the authority every 15 s (read as unreachable past 45 s), renews every 20 s, and stops a frozen child at its checkpoint after 120 s offline (hosts, read by each host's runtime); its wake threshold is the sweeper's 30 s. Progress timeouts by task class are §9.2's (build 180 s, review 90 s); a class not listed has an unknown stall. MC's judgment calls are reserved on fakejudge (its own route, never a worker's), §9.2's cap of 2 calls a day, under 1.0 test_units a day at 0.25 a call, escalating after 2 reviews with no change, at most 2 per item (N3); the coalescing window is the item's class progress timeout. Grace is each host's own fact.
